verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents a `crewai test` CLI command that runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports performance metrics. CrewAI AMP's Visual Agent and Task Builders also offer real-time testing. Nothing in the evidence describes a sandbox or staging environment, or any way to keep test runs away from production data or tools. missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment, isolation from production data and side-effecting tools (e.g. mock tools or test credentials), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
